name: Moped
description: A vehicle on no more than three wheels with an electric motor, or a motor of 50 cc or less, that can't go faster than 50 km/h on level ground with a 60 kg rider; also called a motor assisted pedal bicycle, though it needs no pedals. An e-bike past the power-assisted bicycle limits lands here.

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels, an electric motor of any power or a motor of 50 cc or less, and a top speed of 50 km/h or less on level ground with a 60 kg rider
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, s. 1(j.4)

restrictions.rule: Not a bicycle, and not a motor vehicle except that it must carry compulsory third-party insurance
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, c. H-5, ss. 1(a.1), 1(k.1) and 324

restrictions.rule: Registered with the Registrar, with one number plate on the rear
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act Mopeds (Motor Assisted Bicycles) Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC642/75, ss. 2 and 5

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's licence or a moped operator's licence, available from 16 with a parent's or guardian's written consent under 18
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act Mopeds (Motor Assisted Bicycles) Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC642/75, ss. 7 and 8

restrictions.rule: The rider must wear a helmet approved by the Canadian Standards Association or the Department on a highway, and no one else may ride on it
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act Mopeds (Motor Assisted Bicycles) Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC642/75, s. 10

restrictions.rule: Needs a head lamp lit whenever it moves, a tail lamp, reflectors, and front and rear brakes
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act Mopeds (Motor Assisted Bicycles) Regulations, P.E.I. Reg. EC642/75, ss. 9 and 10

restrictions.rule: One able to exceed 50 km/h is a motorcycle
